correctness.rationale: Full proof from explicit vertex orbits, exact algebraically symbolic verified factorization of the squared ellipsoid gauge, and a weighted covariance determinant-trace certificate for global minimal volume and uniqueness. The factor for penultimate orbit is proportional to m-(n(n+1)-1), with every other deficit nonnegative at/above the threshold and strictly positive above. Sympy independent formal rational simplification returned zero difference in symbolic variables, and the standard-library verifier passed 2070 exact rational instance checks; finite experiments are not the infinite proof. The theorem does not compute the below-threshold optimum.

originality.rationale: Material inspection of arXiv:2207.14253 (partial permutohedra combinatorial/vertex/Ehrhart structure), arXiv:2012.09901 (earlier face/facet formulations), arXiv:2403.06975 (Ehrhart formulas), and Bowman–Heath 2023 (general MVEE theory), with searches for exact geometry, aliases, optimal design, and indexed mathematical findings, did not uncover a statement implying the all-n quadratic contact threshold. The explicitly existing n=2 ellipsoid case is excluded. Synonymous geometric/optimal-design statements could exist, so absolute novelty is not certified.
residual_risks: The theorem could have an existing equivalent formulation under anti-blocking permutohedron geometry or optimal-design theory despite the inspected literature and searches.
The current finding does not evaluate the MVEE at n<=m<n(n+1)-1; the n=2 case is excluded by design.
Full-text searches and inspected material cannot prove universal absence of prior coverage.

value.rationale: A natural two-parameter polytope family has a sharp global transition in the dimension where a simple covariance ellipsoid changes from infeasible to the uniquely optimal Löwner ellipsoid. The result gives exact Euclidean semiaxes, volume, and contact-orbit counts throughout the entire higher-dimensional regime and an exact critical dimension, not a routine numerical benchmark. Lower-dimensional optima remain undetermined.
